title: infrastructure-weekly-update-2026-08-17
body:
TL;DR:
- Cluster utilization averaged ~72% across hosted pools; EU-west-1 continues to be a hotspot (avg 92% peak during weekdays).
- We ran a capacity stress test for a planned retail customer onboarding and identified KV cache memory pressure in us-west-2. Short-term mitigations in place; see actions.
- Procurement ask: propose ordering 40x H100 + 20x Blackwell-class (B100) to cover projected Q4 demand and replace aging A100 nodes in dedicated pools. See capacity forecast.
- Autoscaler v2 canary (us-west-2 + eu-west-1) showed 15% lower p99 tail latency under synthetic burst load; rolling to more regions next week.

1) Current fleet snapshot
- Total GPUs (hosted + dedicated): 2,160 (H100: 820, A100: 900, B100: 220, others: 220)
- Average GPU utilization (hosted clusters, last 7 days): 72%
- Average GPU utilization (dedicated/reserved customers): 58% (but variance by pool: some dedicated pools <20% idle, others pinned >85%)
- Node health: 99.86% up (weekly) with 12 retirements scheduled for A100 nodes next month.

2) Incidents / outages (since last update)
- 2026-08-12 11:10 UTC - Partial throttling in eu-west-1 routing layer causing increased latencies for model-family redwood/v2-*. Root cause: routing table inconsistency during canary rollout. Mitigation: rollback routing config and reapply with stricter validation. Impact: 18 minutes of elevated latencies (p95 +120ms). Postmortem in INFRA-4378.
- 2026-08-14 03:45 UTC - Pod OOM in us-west-2 during retail stress test (KV cache growth). Hotfix: adjust cache eviction watermarks and revert experimental mempolicy. OOM prevented customer traffic by using overflow nodes.

3) Regional notes
- eu-west-1: Sustained high utilization due to two new high-throughput customers. We're throttling low-priority background jobs and asking product to postpone noncritical experiments. Consider short-term burst capacity (10-15 H100) or routing some traffic to eu-central-1.
- us-east-1: Healthy; utilization steady ~65%. Autoscaler v2 performed well in canary.
- us-west-2: Stress-test revealed cache memory fragmentation. Node-level kernel upgrade (5.18 -> 5.19) staged for next week to improve hugepage handling.
- ap-southeast-1: Low utilization; good candidate for routing some eu-west-1 spillover (latency penalty acceptable for batch workloads).

4) Capacity forecast & procurement ask
- Forecast assumptions: 20% month-over-month growth in hosted inference units for Q4 driven by increase in conversational/chat workloads and embeddings. Dedicated bookings on pace to consume an additional ~180 H100-equivalent GPUs by Nov 2026.
- Gap: To maintain 72% target utilization and 99.9% supply SLA for dedicated customers, we estimate needing +60 H100-equivalent GPUs by end of Q3 (buffer included).
- Proposal: Approve purchase of 40x H100 + 20x B100 (Blackwell-class) to fast-track high-throughput capacity and improve price/performance for large-token workloads. Finance pre-check: capital budget flagged but within Q3 procurement envelope if we reallocate part of reserved cloud spend.

5) Autoscaling, software & optimization work
- Autoscaler v2 (canary): Running in us-west-2 and eu-west-1; metrics show 15% decrease in p99 init latency under burst tests and 8% reduction in cold-start GPU waste. Next: expand to us-east-1 and monitor cost delta.
- KV cache improvements: landed PR to implement cache compaction in runtime (runtime PR #289). Early results: 12% reduction in per-request memory footprint in local test harness.
- Batching/cost optimizations: Optimize batching thresholds for streaming workloads; initial tuning for convo workloads reduced per-token GPU time by ~6%.

6) Dedicated & Private customer notes
- Dedicated pool HZ-7 (customer: FinQ) currently at 94% utilization during market open. We have scheduled a separate capacity plan meeting with Sales + Solutions to discuss burst lanes or reserved add-ons.
- Private deployment for PharmaCo: on-prem hardware validation completed; waiting on KMS integration sign-off from Security.

7) Action items / owners
- Priya P. (owner) - finalize procurement request for 40 H100 + 20 B100 and submit to Finance by 2026-08-20.
- Daniel K. - schedule kernel upgrade rollout plan for us-west-2 (target: 2026-08-24).
- Sofia M. - coordinate with Solutions Eng + Sales on FinQ immediate capacity options; propose 2-week runway plan by 2026-08-21.
- Arjun R. - expand autoscaler v2 to us-east-1 canary and add cost telemetry (target: 2026-08-19).
- Maya J. - follow up with Security on KMS flow for PharmaCo private deploy (due: 2026-08-18).

8) Risks & open questions
- Hardware lead times: B100/Blackwell-class cards currently have a 6-8 week lead time; if approved late, we may miss Q4 demand. Consider short-term cloud burst contracts as bridge.
- Cost vs latency trade-offs: routing eu-west-1 spill to ap-southeast-1 reduces latency SLAs for some customers. Need product decision on acceptable latency for background vs foreground workloads.
- Autoscaler side effects: rolling expand needs careful validation of edge cases in bursty multi-tenant pools (ticketed in INFRA-4321).

9) Notes to execs (one-liners)
- We recommend greenlighting the H100+B100 procurement to avoid Q4 capacity crunch; autoscaler improvements are already delivering measurable reductions in cold-start and p99 latency.
- There's a short-term hotspot in eu-west-1; mitigation options include short-term burst capacity purchase, traffic routing changes, or prioritization with product.

If you'd like a capacity table (per-region, per-model family) or the raw utilization dump, I can attach the CSV next update.

-- Priya
(Infra lead)
